steps.name: inspect-live-call-status
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
echo '--- call state ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState=' || true
echo '--- audio mode ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -m1 -E 'mode:|Phone state:' || true
echo '--- app process ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell ps -A | grep "$PKG" || true
echo '--- campaign status ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/<string name="status">([^<]*)<\/string>/STATUS=\1/' | grep -E '^STATUS=' || true
echo '--- focused app ---'
adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -4 || true
